style: Cel-shaded 2D illustration in the style of a hand-painted animated feature. Thick, clean, confident ink outlines of consistent weight. Flat colour fills with soft two-tone cel shading — no airbrush gradients, no photorealism, no 3D render. Roman city of Pompeii, AD 79. Early scenes: warm Mediterranean palette — terracotta red, ochre, sun-bleached plaster white, olive green, sea blue — bright southern Italian daylight. Eruption scenes: the palette collapses into ash grey, charcoal black and bruised purple, with only fire-orange and volcanic-lightning violet as light sources. Portrait/vertical composition, 900x1600, framed for a mobile screen. Keep the lower third of the frame visually calm and uncluttered: character sprites and a text card are composited over it at runtime. Historically grounded first-century Roman architecture and objects. Quiet, oppressive, mounting dread — never gory. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no signature.

scenes.scenes/bakery-dawn.png: Interior of a Roman bakery (pistrinum) in Pompeii before dawn, AD 79. A large brick beehive-shaped bread oven with a glowing firemouth, the only warm light in the dark room. Beside it, tall hourglass-shaped lava-stone flour mills with wooden harness bars for a donkey. A long wooden table crowded with rows and rows of round Roman loaves scored into eight wedges, dozens of them, ready for the oven. Sacks of grain, an oil lamp, strings of garlic. The blue-black of pre-dawn in a small high window. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, oven glow in the upper two thirds, floor simple below.
scenes.scenes/bakery-mill-dawn.png: The milling corner of a Roman bakery (pistrinum) in Pompeii before dawn, AD 79. A donkey in harness, blindfold pushed up on its forehead, leaning into the wooden harness bar of a tall hourglass-shaped lava-stone mill, mid-stride on its worn circular track in the floor. Grain pouring from the mill's funnel-shaped upper stone, fresh flour collecting in the stone catch-basin below. A second idle mill behind it. Warm orange light spilling in from the oven firemouth off to one side, long shadows across the circular track. Sacks of grain, a water trough, a broom against the wall. The donkey is the only living thing in the frame — completely empty of people. Vertical composition, mill and donkey in the upper two thirds, the swept circular track simple and open below.
scenes.scenes/bakery-mill-quake.png: The same milling corner of the Roman bakery at midday, AD 79, during earth tremors. The donkey has stopped dead on its track, braced on all four legs, ears flattened back, head turned, eyes showing white — refusing to move, the harness bar slack against the mill. Flour dust hanging in the air, thin streams sifting from the shaking beams above. Spilled flour on the floor arranged in fine concentric ripple rings, like rings on water. Iron ladles and tools on the wall swinging and knocking together. Sickly yellow-grey daylight from the doorway. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the braced donkey and mill in the upper two thirds, the rippled flour on the floor below.
scenes.scenes/felix-doorstep-morning.png: A narrow side alley in Pompeii at golden early morning, AD 79. In the middle of the frame, the doorway of a modest house: two worn stone steps and a broad threshold slab hollowed by generations of feet, flanked by plain plastered walls with faded red painted election notices. A plain wooden walking stick leaning against the doorframe, an empty clay cup on the step, a cat-worn patch of sun on the stones. The alley opens at the far end onto a bright street, and beyond it, small in the gap between rooftops, the green peaceful shoulder of Vesuvius. Warm ochre and terracotta palette, long morning shadows. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the doorway and alley walls in the upper two thirds, the threshold and paving calm below.
scenes.scenes/felix-doorstep-ash.png: The same narrow Pompeii alley and house doorway in the early afternoon of the eruption, AD 79. Grey ash falling steadily and already lying in a soft even layer on the steps, the threshold slab and the paving. A single round Roman loaf sits alone on the threshold, its crust dusted grey. The wooden walking stick still leaning against the doorframe, untouched. The election notices on the walls half-obscured by ash. At the far end of the alley the street is a murk of falling ash, and the sky above the rooftops is the dim yellow-brown of the eruption cloud. The warm morning palette drained to grey-brown, one weak shaft of sick light. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, doorway and ash-choked alley above, ash-covered threshold below.
scenes.scenes/street-ash-ankle.png: A Pompeii street in the afternoon of the eruption, AD 79, under heavy pumice fall. Ash and pumice lying ankle-deep over the paving, burying the stepping stones and the kerbs, churned by the tracks of many feet. Pumice stones visibly falling through the air in streaks. A pillow tied with cloth bands lying dropped in the ash, a lost sandal, a spilled basket. Shutters torn open, an awning collapsed under the weight of stone. In the far distance up the street, tiny anonymous silhouettes of people trudging away with bundles held over their heads — small, indistinct, no faces. The palette collapsed to ash grey and charcoal, one guttering orange lamp in a doorway. Vertical composition, the ruined street and falling stone in the upper two thirds, deep trampled ash below.
scenes.scenes/low-wall-dark.png: A low field wall of rough stacked stone outside Pompeii in total volcanic darkness, AD 79 — black at what should be afternoon. Ash and pumice drifted deep against the base of the wall, smooth and untrodden. A dead olive tree stripped bare behind it, its branches loaded with grey ash. On the far horizon, a dull red-orange glow where the mountain is, and above it the faintest violet flicker inside the cloud. Almost monochrome: ash grey and charcoal on black, with one distant ember of fire. Utterly still — no falling stone, no movement, the quiet just before the surge. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the black sky and distant glow above, the wall and the drifted ash calm below.
scenes.scenes/market-morning.png: A Pompeii street market at golden early morning, AD 79. Sunlit Roman street with stepping stones, deep wheel ruts, terracotta-roofed shopfronts with wooden shutters opening, awnings, amphorae, hanging fish and bread stalls. People-free foreground. At the far end of the street, above the rooftops, Mount Vesuvius rises green and peaceful against a clear morning sky — quiet, ordinary, unthreatening. Warm terracotta and ochre palette. Completely empty of people in the near view; distant figures at most tiny silhouettes. Vertical composition, the mountain framed at the top third, street receding below.
scenes.scenes/bakery-quake.png: Interior of the same Roman bakery at midday, AD 79, during earth tremors. Flour dust hanging in the air and sifting down in thin streams from the shaking roof beams. A shelf of clay pots tilted, one jar fallen and cracked, flour spilled in rings on the floor. The oven firemouth still glowing. Harsh midday light through the doorway beginning to turn a sickly yellow-grey. Ropes and tools swinging slightly. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, trembling shelves and beams in the upper two thirds, floor open below.
scenes.scenes/street-eruption.png: A Pompeii street at early afternoon, AD 79, moments after the eruption begins. Above the rooftops, a colossal dark eruption column rises from Vesuvius, spreading flat at the top like an immense umbrella pine tree, filling half the sky. The daylight has turned dim and yellow-brown. Fine grey ash beginning to dust the terracotta roofs and street like dirty snow. Doors thrown open, an overturned basket of bread on the paving stones, an abandoned handcart. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the monstrous pine-tree cloud dominating the upper half, ash-dusted street below.
scenes.scenes/harbor-chaos.png: The river harbor of Pompeii under ashfall, AD 79. The water surface completely covered with floating grey pumice stones, like a lid of moving rubble — no open water visible. Roman merchant boats and small craft stuck fast in the pumice, oars jammed upright, one boat listing. Ash falling like grey snow from a black-brown sky, torches on the quay glowing weak orange halos. Coiled ropes, dropped bundles and abandoned baggage on the dock. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, choked sea and trapped boats in the upper two thirds, dock planks below.
scenes.scenes/city-gate-ash.png: The Nuceria gate of Pompeii in unnatural afternoon darkness, AD 79. A Roman city gate arch of large stone blocks, seen from inside, opening onto a road that vanishes into churning black-grey murk. Ash falling heavily. Above and behind, the eruption column flickers with branched violet volcanic lightning inside the cloud — the only bright thing in a black sky. A few dropped possessions on the ash-covered road: a sandal, a bundle, an oil lamp still burning. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the dark arch and lightning-lit cloud in the upper two thirds.
scenes.scenes/interior-collapse.png: The atrium of a Roman house in Pompeii during heavy pumice fall, AD 79. The central skylight opening (compluvium) choked with grey pumice pouring through in a thin cascade onto the rain pool below, which is heaped over with stones. A roof beam sagging, cracked plaster, a household shrine (lararium) niche with small bronze figures and a guttering oil lamp. Dust shaking loose from the ceiling. Ash-grey gloom with one warm lamp glow. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the sagging roof and choked skylight in the upper two thirds.
scenes.scenes/ash-road-dark.png: A road outside Pompeii in total volcanic darkness, AD 79 — midnight-black at what should be afternoon. Deep grey ash and pumice drifted like snow, knee-high, with a trampled path through it. The faint shapes of a toppled cart wheel and a dead torch half-buried. In the far distance behind, a dull red-orange glow on the horizon where the mountain is, and a last few flakes of ash drifting through the dark. Almost monochrome: ash grey on black with one ember of distant fire. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, oppressive darkness above, the pale trampled ash path below.
scenes.scenes/nuceria-dawn.png: A hilltop near Nuceria at true dawn, the morning after the eruption, AD 79. In the foreground, frost-pale grass and a dirt road on the hill. Below and far away, the bay of Naples under a shroud: where the city of Pompeii stood there is only a flat, featureless plain of pale grey ash, and above it the towering column of smoke still rising, lit pink and gold on one side by the sunrise. The sky clearing to a tender, indifferent morning blue. Completely empty of people. Vertical composition, the distant ash plain and column in the upper two thirds, hilltop grass below.
scenes.scenes/modern-casts.png: The archaeological site of modern Pompeii, present day, in a quiet gallery of finds. In the upper part, a glass display case holding two plaster body casts lying close together side by side, softly lit, resting on grey volcanic ash. Nearby on a shelf inside the glass, a row of dark carbonized round Roman loaves scored into wedges. Beyond the glass, out of focus, the excavated ruins and umbrella pines of Pompeii under a clear blue Italian sky, Vesuvius faint on the horizon. Respectful, still, museum-quiet mood. Completely empty of living people. Vertical composition, the display case in the upper two thirds, floor calm below.

characters.modestus: Modestus, a Roman master baker of Pompeii, AD 79, about fifty years old. Stocky and broad-armed from decades of kneading, a round weathered face, short grey-flecked dark hair, heavy brows, flour dusted on his forearms and the front of his clothes. A practical man attached to his trade and his till — stubborn rather than cruel. A knee-length off-white wool tunic with rolled sleeves, a leather work apron marked with flour and scorch marks, a cord belt with a small key ring and coin pouch, simple leather sandals. Full body, facing the viewer, standing straight, feet planted, arms hanging slightly away from the sides so that each arm reads as a clearly separated shape against the torso. Neutral, even lighting with no cast shadow on the ground. Isolated on a plain flat magenta background, pure #FF00FF, for cutout.
characters.casta: Casta, a young enslaved bakery worker in Pompeii, AD 79, about nineteen years old. Slight and quick, olive skin, dark hair tied back simply with a few strands loose, large attentive dark eyes, a steady, warm, unsentimental expression — someone who works hard and notices everything. A plain undyed rough-spun ankle-length tunic with a simple cloth belt, sleeves to the elbow, flour on her hands and hem, worn leather sandals. A single small bronze hairpin in her hair, her only possession. Full body, facing the viewer, standing straight, feet planted, arms hanging slightly away from the sides so that each arm reads as a clearly separated shape against the torso. Neutral, even lighting with no cast shadow on the ground. Isolated on a plain flat magenta background, pure #FF00FF, for cutout.
characters.felix: Felix, an old free neighbor in Pompeii, AD 79, about seventy years old. Thin and sun-dried, deeply lined kind face, sparse white hair and white stubble, one hand resting on a plain wooden walking stick, the other relaxed. He survived the great earthquake seventeen years ago; his legs no longer run. A faded brown-grey wool tunic to the knee, a threadbare cloak over one shoulder, a rope belt, worn sandals. An expression of calm, tired knowing — a man who recognizes what is coming and holds no illusions for himself. Full body, facing the viewer, standing straight, feet planted, arms hanging slightly away from the sides so that each arm reads as a clearly separated shape against the torso. Neutral, even lighting with no cast shadow on the ground. Isolated on a plain flat magenta background, pure #FF00FF, for cutout.
